Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in the very first step by failing to extract the correct death date from the initial WebSurfer search results. Although the WebSurfer provided a snippet from Wikipedia (visible in the first search results) showing "8 June 1829 - 13 August 1896", the Planner overlooked this information and instead relied on a misleading snippet from a second search (which incorrectly showed 1931) to formulate a plan. This led to unnecessary steps of re-verifying a date that was already available in the initial results, and the Planner failed to synthesize the available data to solve the problem immediately.
